svg.title: dsh-legal-intake: one batch, one parse, two gates - read-only doctor vs. dedupe-classify-export write path
svg.desc: A batch of three synthetic EML messages is parsed once by parseEml(). Band 01 shows the input files together with the parse result: Subject and From are required, Date is optional, a missing Message-ID falls back to mid-<content hash> and a missing Thread-Id falls back to the Message-ID. A fork then feeds two gates. Gate 02 is read-only and never throws: legal_intake_doctor reports four codes for this sample (E_LEGAL_MESSAGE_DUPLICATE, E_LEGAL_THREAD_REPEATED, E_LEGAL_ATTACHMENT_DUPLICATE, E_LEGAL_ATTACHMENT_EMPTY); legal_conflict_check takes a separate parties input, normalises names and reports opposing sides. Gate 03 is the local write path: legal_intake dedupes against seen Message-IDs (3 messages become 2 new requests and 1 duplicate that is counted but not stored), classifies in the fixed order NDA, MSA, CONTRACT_REVIEW, DISPUTE, COMPLIANCE, OTHER (this sample: NDA 1, MSA 1), stores two records in the legal domain requests table (request_id = req_ + sha256(Message-ID)[:12], status new), and legal_export_ledger writes exports/intake-ledger.xlsx with sheet Requests and 2 rows. The footer keeps the boundary visible: the source is read-only, there is no network and no model call, and writes go only to exports/ and legal.requests.

text.font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei','Segoe UI','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif

svg.text: One batch, two gates: a read-only doctor on one side, dedupe → classify → export on the other.
